notes: The LED on pin 13 is the Uno's built-in LED, so no external LED is added; the manual lists none.

In the circuit image the potentiometer's three legs sit in columns 10, 11 and 12. The outer legs are in the bottom half of the board and carry the black GND wire (column 10) and the red 5V wire (column 12). The middle (wiper) leg extends across the centre channel and the yellow A0 wire ends in the top half of column 11.
Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue convention (bank 't' rows a-e, bank 'b' rows f-j). The image labels the rows the other way round. Only the strip (column and bank) matters electrically.
The black wire lands on the second GND pin of the Uno power header, which I have named GND.2. The schematic shows only 'GND', so this pin choice is an assumption.
The potentiometer's two outer legs are interchangeable. I assigned GND to column 10 (black wire) and VCC to column 12 (red wire).
I assumed the yellow wire's other end is in 11t.d, in the same strip as the wiper leg at 11t.e. The image does not show the exact row.
